finalText:
**Redis outage cascaded into a full outage.**

`Redis` died at `02:14:07` (`ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379`). Reconnects kept failing every ~80s, up to attempt 12 at `02:31:26`, never recovering.

Without cache, every request hit the store directly. Queue depth climbed from 52 to 568, well past the max of 500, while timeouts fired every few seconds for 17 straight minutes.

At `02:31:44` `worker-2` hit `JavaScript heap out of memory` from the request backlog and crashed. At `02:31:52` the `api` process stopped responding and `[supervisor]` killed the whole process group.

Root cause: `Redis` at `10.0.0.12:6379` went unreachable and never came back.

Next: check why `Redis` at `10.0.0.12` dropped and restore it first.
